info.name: HERO Stories CRUD - Phase 2 Backend
info.description:
Complete test collection for HERO Story Form API endpoints

Endpoints:
- POST /api/career-id/profile/:profileId/hero-stories (create)
- GET /api/career-id/profile/:profileId/hero-stories (list)
- GET /api/career-id/profile/:profileId/hero-stories/:storyId (fetch)
- PATCH /api/career-id/profile/:profileId/hero-stories/:storyId (update)
- DELETE /api/career-id/profile/:profileId/hero-stories/:storyId (delete)

Setup:
1. Set collection variables: {{profileId}} and {{baseUrl}}
2. Run requests in order
3. Use storyId from POST response for subsequent requests

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Led complete redesign of customer portal to reduce support tickets",
  "hurdleProblem": "Our 10-year-old customer portal was outdated and slow, generating 200 support tickets per week due to poor UX",
  "hurdleScope": "Affected 50,000+ enterprise customers across 3 regions",
  "hurdleStakes": "Customer churn was at 5% annually; losing market share to competitors with modern portals",
  "expectationRole": "Technical Lead and Product Owner",
  "expectationGoals": "Reduce support tickets by 50%, improve portal performance by 10x, modernize tech stack",
  "expectationConstraints": "6-month timeline, $500k budget, must maintain backward compatibility",
  "responseActions": "Architected new React-based portal with AWS Lambda backend; led cross-functional team of 8 engineers; implemented phased rollout",
  "responseTools": "React, TypeScript, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform, GitHub Actions",
  "responseChallenges": "Coordinated data migration from legacy system; maintained uptime during rollout; trained customer success team on new features",
  "outcomeDeliverable": "Production-ready portal deployed to 100% of customer base with zero downtime migration",
  "outcomeMetrics": "Support tickets reduced from 200/week to 85/week (57% reduction); portal load time decreased from 8s to 0.8s; customer satisfaction increased from 6.2 to 8.1/10",
  "outcomeImpact": "Recognized as key initiative in annual review; awarded 'Technical Excellence' prize; industry recognition in customer conference keynote"
}
